sys_atf_test.name: Day-2 SAM: JWS verification binds subject and decision, not just signature
sys_atf_test.description: A signed assertion must bind the request id, the subject and an approved decision. Signature validity alone answers "is this authentic", never "does it authorise this grant for this person".

sys_atf_step.description: Assert test_mode is on, and that verifyJws's canned claim set carries the three bindings the endpoint requires. A canned set missing requested_for would make every JWS push in this suite fail closed for the wrong reason.
SIGNED-BUT-DENIED must be refused. Replays the endpoint's decision gate over a claim set whose status is 'denied'. The old JWS branch returned ok:true here and the push created a RITM.

SUBJECT REDIRECTION must be refused. Replays the endpoint's subject binding: a claim set whose requested_for differs from the pushed requested_for is a valid signature pointed at a different person, and must not verify.
No lineage row may exist for any of the refused JWS request ids — a refused verification must not leave correlation state behind.
sys_atf_step.inputs: table = x_fed_day2_ops_integration conditions = record_type=sam_lineage^sam_request_idSTARTSWITHATF-SAM-JWS assert = zero matching rows
